devices.name: Core2
board_work: ILI9342 pixel-stream/live-frame polish
physical cache/PSRAM timing equivalence
nine-instance ACK stability, a current-load eight-instance cold-start rebind and sustained HCI/GATT throughput
blockers: Core2 legacy UIFlow shared I2C, equal-deadline timer, TIMG WDT level delivery, classic WiFi and startup UI are fixed. Patches 0036-0042 add stateful SSI, unified timeline, exact-time pause/state sweep, BIN-bound setter trace, bounded register/object/stack dumps, and a partial SPI TRANS_DONE/TRANS_INTEN IRQ model. Patch 0064 fixes pending SPI source delivery when the interrupt matrix is remapped while the level is already high; an isolated ESP-IDF SPI3 guest probe changes from pre-fix callback timeout to fixed 3/3 PASS. Patch 0068 attaches the same ILI9342 panel sink to legacy HSPI/SPI2 and UIFlow2 VSPI/SPI3. Patch 0095 fixes legacy task-WDT level delivery: three independent normal-WDT Device Service runs of the same public firmware exceed the former 15.55-second stage-1 reset, complete boot and reconnect activity, and retain the nonempty API Key startup UI beyond 300 seconds virtual time. One additional normal-WDT run renders the real Wi-Fi Connect/Connecting to myssid page. Temporary bulk-read and watchdog-disable diagnostics are not product fixes
The historical WDT-off CPU1 0x40100049 LVGL wait is not reproduced in the corrected WiFi-backed lane and requires a new same-lane binding
physical cache/PSRAM timing equivalence remains NOT RUN
bit-exact ESP32 BT baseband/controller remains NOT RUN

virtual-device concurrency gates cover the current service capacity of eight sessions per device; more-than-eight-instance stability is rejected after a reproducible NimBLE ACK panic at nine sessions, current-load eight-instance cold-start rebind, sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop remain OPEN (CORE2-02)
the bounded-TCG host-memory result is validated only for the tested long-hold workload

validation.ack_observability: Patch 0010 preserves opt-in ACK-state observability. In the historical zero-stagger five-instance diagnostic, the first Reset Complete response-to-HLI timestamp delta was 4.506306s of host trace time, not guest virtual time; at the first ACK check ack=NULL and semaphore count 0.
validation.concurrency_validation: Two independent two-instance no-stagger 4x120s gates pass 8/8, two independent three-instance 3x120s gates pass 6/6, and two independent four-instance 4x120s gates pass 8/8. Patch 0008 preallocates real guest HCI-event buffers and ACL mbufs while CPU0 is idle, and patch 0009 expands the real reserve to 8 event/4 ACL objects. Every passing historical lease records 36 events/9 ACLs on the fast path, HLI 45/45 and hli-errors=0. Two independent five-instance 5x120s batches with a 30-second startup stagger pass 10/10 and two zero-stagger six-instance gates pass 12/12. The earlier shift=auto zero-stagger five-instance cold start produced one batch passed 5/5 and an independent confirmation failed 3/5. After calibrating the sustained floor to hold/12, two independent eight-instance 8x120s gates pass 16/16 total at the service per-device cap of 8. Under the current QEMU/runtime, two independent zero-stagger 2x60s controls pass 4/4 using a three-sweep hold/40 floor and bounded HTTP/public recheck retries; PSRAM and recoverable network errors have separate evidence fields. Every passing current 2x60s lease has hli-errors=0. Three independent zero-stagger 9x120s attempts produced 9/9, 9/9 and 8/9. The failure was observed at real concurrency 9 and panicked in ble_hs_hci_process_ack at PC 0x402630cc; the following 0x40092e43 panic occurred during reboot. Nine-instance capacity is rejected, DEFAULT_MAX_PER_DEVICE and runner concurrency remain 8, and concurrency 9 is fail-closed. A current-load zero-stagger eight-instance cold-start rebind remains open because host contention prevented all leases from completing guest BLE initialization. more-than-eight-instance stability remains OPEN. Sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop also remain OPEN.
validation.memory_validation: The m5core2 machine now exposes a QOM-effective 8 MiB PSRAM device. Normal ESP32 DRAM1 remains a 4 MiB directly mapped heap window; a dedicated ESP-IDF esp_himem probe passed in three independent Device Service leases, mapping two different 32 KiB physical blocks through the same virtual MMU window and verifying both after remap (4,456,448 bytes himem capacity, 262,144-byte reserve). Guest sustained stress remains PASS in three independent 120-second leases (35/35/35 checks, 105 MiB total) and one 600-second lease (179 checks). Physical PSRAM/cache timing remains NOT RUN.
validation.detail: Official UIFlow2 v2.5.3 runs the 320x240 display/touch, AXP2101, INA3221, MPU6886, PCF8563, NS4168 speaker, SPM1423 microphone, OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP, public DNS/HTTP and stock-firmware external BLE GATT in one m5core2 guest. The canonical Device Service profile core2-native-hci passes the HCI-4 functional baseline, bounded native-HCI holds, active-stop and eight-session concurrency. Three independent leases complete 121 reconnect cycles with HLI 3405/3405; an artifact-bound tb-size=128 7200s active-BLE WiFi/public-network/GATT hold remains functionally PASS with bounded host memory. The m5core2 machine exposes an 8 MiB PSRAM device and models DRAM1 32 KiB MMU pages. Legacy UIFlow now has replayable shared-I2C, CCOMPARE, TIMG WDT level delivery, QIO/stateful-SSI, unified handoff, exact-time, setter-trace, WDT-liveness, WDT-off late-state, pending-SPI-remap and dual-SPI panel-routing evidence. Patch 0095's three independent normal-WDT Device Service runs exceed the former 15.55-second reset, retain boot/reconnect progress and keep the API Key startup UI beyond 300 seconds virtual time; one run renders the real Wi-Fi Connect screen. Patch 0085 adds the Core2-for-AWS ATECC608 initialization/identity path and classic DMA link/DC handling; three independent public-firmware leases render a nonempty frame. Two current-tool-hash zero-stagger 2x60s controls pass 4/4 with three PSRAM sweeps and repeated controlled/public HTTP checks. Three nine-instance attempts produced 9/9, 9/9 and 8/9; the failure panicked in ble_hs_hci_process_ack at 0x402630cc, so nine-instance capacity is rejected and the default remains eight. No production key, ECDSA signing, live trust root, electrical equivalence or hardware validation is claimed. Setup/REPL interaction and a complete legacy factory application remain open. The old CPU1 0x40100049 LVGL wait is not reproduced in this corrected lane and requires a new same-lane binding. The legacy core2-native-vhci profile remains diagnostic. A current-load eight-instance cold-start rebind, physical cache/PSRAM equivalence, sustained throughput, teardown modes beyond active-stop and a bit-exact Espressif BT baseband/controller remain open.

devices.name: AtomU
board_work: Official UIFlow2 v2.5.4 AtomU 4MB boot, M5.begin() and M5.getBoard()=130 in one m5atomu guest
Single SK6812 on GPIO27 driven through the ESP32 classic RMT path; QOM decodes the final wire frame as 0x204060 across 5 completed frames
QMP key:a drives GPIO39 through the board input handler and the guest reports press/release and repaints the LED
Guest I2C controller scans the Grove G26/G32 bus (only the QEMU machine's built-in tmp105 0x48 is present)
blockers: Device-local console evidence covers boot, board id 130, RMT SK6812 output, QMP key-driven button and Grove I2C scan only. PDM microphone capture, IR and Grove Unit protocols remain open; hardware behavior is NOT RUN.

validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.4 AtomU 4MB 镜像在同一 m5atomu guest 内完成 ROM/二级 bootloader、M5.begin()、M5.getBoard()=130、GPIO27 SK6812 的 RMT 输出（QOM 解码 0x204060，5 帧）、QMP key:a 驱动 GPIO39 的按下/释放回读，以及 G26/G32 上 guest I2C 控制器扫描。无屏/无 PSRAM；SPM1423 PDM 麦克风、IR、Grove Unit 与物理行为未验证。三次矩阵运行 PASS。

validation.detail: 官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.4 Atom Echo 4MB 镜像在同一 m5atomecho guest 内完成 ROM/二级 bootloader、M5.begin()、M5.getBoard()=142、GPIO27 SK6812 的 RMT 输出（QOM 解码 0x204060，5 帧）、QMP key:a 驱动 GPIO39 的按下/释放回读、G26/G32 guest I2C 扫描（0x48 为 QEMU 机器自带 tmp105，0x18 ES8311 不存在）、NS4168 I2S 扬声器在 I2S1 DMA 边界的非静音 PCM 捕获，以及 SPM1423 PDM 麦克风在 I2S0 上消费宿主注入 PCM 的非零缓冲。无屏/无 PSRAM；模拟功放/声学、IR、Grove Unit 与物理行为未验证。三次矩阵运行 PASS。

devices.name: M5Stick
board_work: Official M5Stick EasyLoader FactoryTest 4 MB image loads through ROM/bootloader into the app in deterministic icount mode; native serial marker mpu9250 addr: FF observed
SH1107 mono SPI panel model receives the complete 64x128 init sequence plus 4096 GDDRAM data bytes (1024 non-zero) from the factory firmware
MPU9250 0x68 and IP5306 0x75 models attached to the shared G21/G22 bus; generic classic-ESP32 MicroPython fixture reads WHO_AM_I 0x71, accel frame, IP5306 SYS 0xbe/READ4 0xff
QOM accel-x fixture 2.0 is read back as raw 8192 by the guest; QMP key injection drives GPIO35 low/high and the guest reports both states
blockers: The EasyLoader factory firmware's legacy ESP-IDF I2C FIFO data path does not complete against the classic I2C model, so its MPU probe reports 0xFF and the factory firmware stalls before the menu/button stage; AK8963/DMP, final SH1107 UI frame, buzzer/IR/LED, Grove Units, black/gray revision distinction and physical acoustics/optics/electrics remain open.

validation.detail: 官方 EasyLoader FactoryTest 镜像（安装包 SHA-256 99c640b0…；规范化 4 MB 镜像 SHA-256 84228dfb…）在独立 m5stick machine 内完成 ROM/二级 bootloader 加载并在 icount 确定性模式下输出原生串口 `mpu9250 addr: FF`；SH1107 收到完整 64x128 初始化命令流与 4,096 字节 GDDRAM 写周期（含 1,024 字节非零内容），但工厂固件随后停滞，未到达 UI 绘制/按键阶段。MPU9250/IP5306/GPIO35 模型数据面由 generic classic-ESP32 MicroPython fixture 在同一 machine 上取证。

devices.name: M5StickT2
board_work: Bare-metal probe (committed source, ELF SHA recorded in evidence) boots through QEMU -kernel on m5stickt2 and prints STICKT2 markers over UART0
FLIR Lepton CCI at I2C 0x2A: PING, 8-word serial, FPA/AUX temperature GET and OEM sync SET commands are served by the 16-bit CCI register model

VoSPI over classic HSPI with GPIO0 chip select: 164-byte packets, 4 segments x 60 packets per 160x120 frame; three consecutive guest FNV-1a digests match the independent host fixture oracle (seed 0/1/2) with zero packet errors
ST7789 135x240 panel over VSPI: init sequence and full-frame thermal render produce a 135x240 QMP screenshot with 32,400 non-black pixels and 89 unique colors
QOM encoder increment=5 is read back by the guest I2C encoder path; AXP192/PCF8563/MPU6886 models are attached but not exercised by the probe

Official M5StickT User Demo (4 MB, SHA-256 bb33ffd4…) boots to its app marker under deterministic icount after the classic UART TX_DONE latch fix; its thermal/UI path remains unpinned and cannot be probe-injected
blockers: Thermal virtual-device data plane passed with the committed bare-metal probe: Lepton CCI commands/PID-free register path, deterministic VoSPI frames matching the host fixture oracle, ST7789 panel screenshot and encoder QOM injection. The official M5Burner StickT2 User Demo (SHA-256 bb33ffd4…) reaches its app boot marker under deterministic icount but its thermal/UI path is not reached and cannot be probe-injected; physical LWIR optics/thermal measurement, Grove Units, PDM microphone, encoder hardware and full factory UI remain open.

validation.detail: 自建 bare-metal 探针（tests/uiflow2/stickt2_probe，xtensa-esp-elf 14.2.0 编译，ELF SHA-256 记录在证据中）由 QEMU -kernel 加载到新 machine `m5stickt2`，经真实内存映射控制器完成：UART0 标记输出；GPIO bit-bang I2C 上的 FLIR Lepton CCI （PING/序列号/FPA+AUX 温度/OEM sync 设置，16-bit CCI 寄存器）；HSPI 上的 VoSPI 流（164 字节包、4 段×60 包/frame，CRC 字段本固件不校验）解出 160×120 热帧，连续 3 帧的 guest FNV-1a digest 与宿主按模型 fixture seed 0/1/2 独立重建完全一致、0 包错误；ST7789 135×240 面板经 VSPI 初始化并渲染热帧，QMP 截图 135×240、32,400 非黑像素、89 种颜色；QOM 注入 encoder increment=5 被 guest 读回。另：官方 M5Burner `StickT2 User Demo` v1.0 4 MB 镜像在确定性 icount 下经 classic UART TX_DONE latch 修复后可启动到 `M5StickC initializing...OK`，但其热成像/UI 路径未在运行窗口内到达且不可注入探针，因此不作为数据面证据。物理 LWIR 光学/热测量、Grove、PDM 麦克风、编码器实际接线（文档 PA2/PA3/PA4 与官方示例 I2C 0x30 的矛盾按官方示例取 I2C 0x30）与完整工厂 UI 未验证。
